state.title: Preserve valid manifest inventory when Graphify reports error-free empty output as failed
state.body:
## Scope
Complete the live Codebase rollout from #67. Four managed maps are ready, but rocm-cli fails at historical commit 1cb72e8eec2b on a valid workspace-only Cargo.toml.

Reproduction: `factory codebase --ref 1cb72e8eec2b --limit 1` in rocm-cli fails in ~2 seconds. A fresh Git repository containing only `[workspace]\nmembers = []\n` as Cargo.toml fails in 0.1 seconds.

Root cause confirmed against pinned graphifyy 0.9.56: the PUBLIC `graphify.manifest_ingest.extract_package_manifest` returns `{nodes: [], edges: []}` with no error for a virtual workspace (intentionally no fabricated package node). The aggregate `graphify.extract.extract` nevertheless includes the same path in `failed_sources`. Factory currently treats every member of that lossy list as fatal.

Correct this boundary using Graphify's existing public manifest classifier/parser, for ALL recognized manifest formats, not a Cargo filename/content special case. When a reported failed tracked manifest is independently confirmed to have error-free empty nodes AND edges, retain it as inventory through the existing normalization/warning path. Keep real parser errors, malformed payloads and all other extraction failures fatal. Do not fabricate nodes, weaken failure/cache semantics, monkeypatch installed dependencies, add a parser/dependency, upgrade Graphify, suppress warnings or execute checked-out source.

## Touches
factory/codebase.py extraction boundary, tests/test_codebase.py one real regression, existing CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry and existing README Codebase coverage text if needed. Integration owner seeds the assigned branch before releasing it to the normal worker.

## Exit gate
- A real pinned-Graphify regression exercises a workspace-only Cargo.toml AND a tool-only pyproject.toml in a disposable repository. Both remain visible inventory with no invented relationships and with visible coverage limits.
- A subsequent malformed manifest remains a fatal extraction error and must not overwrite the previous successfully published history.
- Regression fails before the fix and passes after; normal Factory gate, independent review and GitHub CI pass.
- The original rocm-cli single-commit command works with the candidate; after normal merge and pinned District upgrade all five installed /api/codebase surfaces become ready.
- PR targets main, NOT the default stable release branch. Do not change stable or create a tag.

## Out of scope
Unrelated Graphify parser work, schema/UI redesign, accepting arbitrary failed_sources as success, changing unrelated repositories or their worktrees, hidden fallback graphs, broad test/lint cleanup, and unrelated deployment changes.
